g.text: Phase 2 (tag p2): kernel + extension points, plugins, host
Plugins import only "@svgframe/kernel" (domain abstractions + extension interfaces);
the kernel imports no plugin and enumerates no plugin-provided name.
Only main.ts names concrete plugins (dotted arrow).
